strengths.evidence: Marathon finished Sep 2026; 50-60 km weeks in Aug/Sep; VO2max 54

limiters.evidence: Last 3 wks only 12-16 km/wk; LT pace 5:18/km is slower than sub-3:30 MP (4:58)

constraints: 5 runs/wk from wk 4: Tue quality, Wed easy, Thu MP or progression (alternating), Fri easy + strides, Sun long
Heavy lifting Mon (deadlift) / Wed (bench) / Fri (squat) / Sat (shoulder press); lower body RPE 7-8 max from wk 5
Plan only changes on red flags: HRV <60 two mornings running, RHR 7+ above baseline, pain, illness
Illness 14-16 Nov (fever): wk 3 long run missed, wk 4 rest + easy return
Trip 27 Dec - 3 Jan: 32k moved to 20 Dec, trip week is the down week with one 18k long run
Gurgaon heat/pollution: HR caps over pace
COROS LTHR 166 is stale (held 175 on 10 Nov). 24 Nov 30-min test (moved from 17 Nov, illness) sets real LTHR + LT pace; easy runs then pace band + HR ceiling
Non-negotiable: easy = easy, no unplanned runs, no skipped key sessions, run your session not your partner's, gels on every long run 18k+, pain = stop

pace.easy: interim: HR ≤150, never faster than 6:40/km; reset by 24 Nov test (pace band + HR cap 88% new LTHR)

workouts.name: TATA MUMBAI MARATHON
workouts.description: Race day.
workouts.humanReadable: Goal 3:45 (5:20/km). Km 0-5: 5:25-5:28. Km 5-30: 5:18-5:22, HR 158 or below. Km 30+: hold or push if HR allows. Gel every 30 min.

run.targetPace: 5:18-5:22/km (goal 3:45); 5:13/km only if the 24 Nov test gives LT pace ≤5:05/km and the MP blocks on 20 Dec feel controlled (3:40)
run.notes: Km 0-5 at 5:25-5:28 (crowded, dark, humid). Don't chase pace on Bandra-Worli Sea Link incline — hold effort. Bank nothing. Expect late-race rise toward Peddar Road / Marine Drive and rising heat after ~7 am: if temp >24°C / very humid, add 5-10 s/km and race HR, not pace. Halfway target ~1:53.

nutrition.preRace: Wake 3:00-3:15. 2.5-3 h before: 100-150 g carbs low-fibre (white bread/jam/banana/rice) + 500 ml fluid w/ electrolytes. Gel 15 min pre-start.

products: Gel every 30 min (same brand as long runs)

nutrition.notes: Rehearse exact fuel on wk 7, 8, 9 long runs. Carb load Fri-Sat (8-10 g/kg/day). Nothing new on race day.

taper.notes: Wk 11 ~-30%, wk 12 ~-55% excl race. Keep MP touches. Lower-body lifting light wk 11, none wk 12.
